articles.summary: This year, June 14 not only marks Flag Day, but also National Forklift Safety Day, sponsored by the Industrial Truck Association to highlight the safe use of forklifts and the importance of operator training. articles.title: Celebrating National Forklift Safety Day: Three Ways We Make Forklift Trucks Safer
